EmojiPrompt offers the following contributions: (1) it leverages pre-trained LLMs for generative obfuscation, with obfuscation prompts searched automatically; (2) it integrates both linguistic and non-linguistic elements (e.g., emojis, logical operators) during obfuscation, as such symbolic figures have shown to be effective in abstracting descriptive details while retaining essential content ; and (3) it proposes an atomic-level obfuscation strategy to grant privacy protection against both external probes and internal leakage.

guideline: Human recoverers were asked to identify the original item from a list based on its obfuscation (identification task) and to reconstruct original reviews from obfuscated versions (recovery task). Scores such as identification rate, Cosine Similarity, ROUGE, and METEOR were computed.

For the Item Identification test, recoverers were asked to identify the correct item from a 500-item list based on its obfuscation. For the Review Recovery test, human recoverers were asked to recover the original review from the obfuscated version.
